competitiveTarget: Beat Compass/Redfin/SIR About on STRUCTURE, not scale. OPEN on faces at display scale (shadcn Avatar) plus the branded H1 and one boutique Central Oregon buy-and-sell sentence. 5.0 from 25 stays in the first viewport. Then client reviews as the primary proof (Google score + featured quote — never press). Then dated local closings. Then Contact four-up Call|Text|Email|Schedule. Then office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 + firm OREA. Then a compact inquiry that GET-submits to Contact. FAIL if the first viewport is a downtown storefront with no broker face. FAIL if a KPI grid, three equal broker Cards, or a Meet-the-Team dump opens the page. Deep bios stay on /team. Skip coast-to-coast, Redfin fee, and Rocket copy. Never invent MOS, prices, or licenses. BELOW THE PROOF (Matt 2026-09-23, the About-page AEO playbook): What Ryan Realty does (each service an H3), What makes Ryan Realty different (our own checkable facts with their figures; never a named competitor), Who Ryan Realty works with (clients by need), How Ryan Realty works (same business day), The team behind Ryan Realty, Key facts about Ryan Realty as one crawlable dl, and Frequently asked questions as H3s equal to the FAQPage JSON-LD. We win the answer-engine read on structure: every fact a buyer or an engine asks about a brokerage is on this page, sourced, in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (cream under the firm-story hero, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFirm
requiredComponents.section: OPENS THE PAGE. Faces at display scale (shadcn AvatarGroup, image, fallback, badge). Branded H1 and one purpose line — small boutique brokerage, all of Central Oregon, help buy and sell. 5.0 from 25 stays in the first viewport. Navy/cream. NOT a downtown storefront postcard. NOT a KPI grid. NOT three broker Cards. NOT Meet the Team. The primary reviews beat is the V3Proof band that follows. Office photo lives on AboutOffice.

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: PRIMARY client-reviews proof, immediately after the firm hero. Display-scale Google score + featured quote as words (headingLevel 2), door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews). Must read as the first proof band — not a thin score link that loses to closings or CTA. Do not muddle with press. Do not invent a rating. The count and average are sourced or omitted.

requiredComponents.name: FirmClosings
requiredComponents.section: SALES PROOF. Recent local closings as shadcn carousel + Card (photo, address, recorded ClosePrice, close date, beds/baths/sqft, listing door). Dated sold homes from the firm record. Not national scale counts. Never invent MOS or prices. Child of the page so about/page.tsx never mounts a city-stats Ledger.

requiredComponents.name: AboutReach
requiredComponents.section: #reach equal four-up: catalog Button Group Call | Text | Email | Schedule. V3OnDuty hours sit above. Replaces the seven-row contact list SITE-48 removed.

requiredComponents.name: AboutOffice
requiredComponents.section: Bend office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 and firm OREA on the fold. Catalog Card demo (photo, body, facts). One door to /team. No faces, no roster, no per-broker CTAs.

requiredComponents.name: AboutInquiry
requiredComponents.section: One short inquiry on About. Catalog Input + Button. Native GET to /contact?inquiry=. Label Send a message. Not a second ContactAsk. Full form stays on Contact.

requiredComponents.name: V3Entries
requiredComponents.section: #services 'What Ryan Realty does' (Matt 2026-09-23). Six services, each an H3 with two or three sentences on what it is and the outcome and one door to the page that delivers it: selling (3% listing fee from LISTING_TERMS), buying, the free written valuation within 24 hours, relocation, rural/land/resort property, investment property. Never commercial or property management.

requiredComponents.name: V3Claims
requiredComponents.section: #different 'What makes Ryan Realty different' (Matt 2026-09-23). Five of our own checkable facts, each led by its figure on the navy band: Google rating and count (live), 3% listing fee, written valuation in 24 hours, recorded closings count since the first close (live), one broker first call to closing. NO competitor named, no comparison. A claim whose live figure did not load is dropped.

requiredComponents.name: V3Roll
requiredComponents.section: #clients 'Who Ryan Realty works with' (Matt 2026-09-23). A bulleted list of client segments by need (first-time buyers, sellers, people relocating, second-home and resort-community buyers, land and rural buyers, investors, brokers referring a client), each a door. Never a protected class.

requiredComponents.name: V3Steps
requiredComponents.section: #how-we-work 'How Ryan Realty works' (Matt 2026-09-23). The promise 'We reply the same business day.' (Matt's commitment) in the display face, the live office hours from crm_company_settings.booking_hours and the office beside it, and three H3 steps: channels, the first conversation, one broker through closing.

requiredComponents.name: V3Facts
requiredComponents.section: #key-facts 'Key facts about Ryan Realty' (Matt 2026-09-23). ONE dl in the served HTML: Company name, Type, Founded, Founder, Brokers, Headquarters, Website, Core offering, Pricing, Services, Communication, Office hours, Service area, Brokerage license, Clients served (live closings count with its date span), Reviews (live Google count and average), Social. No Notable clients, no Competitors, no Contract terms.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Once: #about, 'The team behind Ryan Realty' (Matt 2026-09-23), late: 'How it started' (the origin, Matt Ryan owner and principal broker, Ryan Realty LLC since 2014, Bend office June 2023, the Red Erickson line), 'The brokers' (the licensed-broker count from the live roster, a door to each broker's /team page as one inline line, never roster cards), the firm and principal-broker licences as sourced facts, and the firm's social profiles. Never a KPI Instrument. The second instance (#who, seven contact rows as the fold) was deleted by SITE-48.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. 'Frequently asked questions' (Matt 2026-09-23): eight questions as H3s (questionHeadings), answers two or three sentences, from the one aboutFaqItems array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits (roster names, the fee from LISTING_TERMS, the same business day reply, the office and its live hours, the firm license, Tumalo). Native disclosures, closed rows still in the served HTML, with the outbound doors in the left rail. Before 2026-09-23: the same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with the three edges /about has not offered yet (Value my home, Homes for sale, Central Oregon housing market) in the left rail. Replaces the closing V3Quiet 2026-09-02: as prose it measured 1,491px at 1440 with 8 paragraphs, no figure and no control, which is the wall of text TASTE.md bans by name, and four of those paragraphs restated a section above them. The D11 mission sentence went with them — VOICE.md permits it on About and requires it nowhere, and it opened on smallness positioning. No answer moved behind script: a closed disclosure is still in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door, the region's listings as dots, one claim sentence from the same population the homepage hero reads (buildPlaceAtlas, one source). Replaces the city ledger 2026-09-02 (Matt: every page interactive, no scrolling lists).

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

requiredComponents.name: V3OnDuty
requiredComponents.section: The live state on the reach control: our published booking hours against the Pacific clock, from the same crm_company_settings.booking_hours rows /book offers time from. NEVER a reply-time figure — see components/site/v3/V3OnDuty.view.ts and SITE-09. The reply-time PROMISE (same business day, Matt 2026-09-23) is a commitment and lives in V3Steps #how-we-work, not on this clock.

tasteReview.beats: Compass's generic agent-team 'About' bio wall — this page wins on sourced proof (a closings carousel with real address/ClosePrice/beds-baths-sqft and a dated Google-review footnote), but its flat clients list and generic three-step block still read thinner than Compass's photography-led team copy.

defects.finding: Six client segments render as a plain stack of underlined text lines with zero visual encoding — no icon, image, or card despite the brief calling for a display-type roll; it's a headline dressed as a link list, the dullest block on the page.

Five navy stat tiles read as a KPI grid; only the closings tile (Bend office dot-strip) rewards a hover, the other four (5.0, 3%, 24hr, 1 broker) are static numbers with a caption and never invite interaction.

Two prose paragraphs (How it started / The brokers) carry the section, with broker faces shrunk to ~32px thumbnails — a text-dominant block on an otherwise photo-led page, inconsistent with the display-scale AvatarGroup used in the hero.

Three numbered circles joined by a hairline is the generic SaaS onboarding-strip shape; nothing moves, nothing reveals on hover, and the form is indistinguishable from a thousand other sites' 'how it works' rail.

Same rubric v1-2026-09-12. The new median (63) sits above the prior 55, but a different judge is not a baseline, so this is the first mark on the claude-sonnet-5 instrument.
tasteReview.verdict: demoMatch is true — the hero AvatarGroup now genuinely overlaps at display scale, and the closings Carousel, Button Group, and Input are real catalog interactions in house navy/cream, not cream boxes. But originality still lags: the differentiators band is a KPI grid softened by one hover-able dot strip, the clients section is a bare underlined text list standing in for the promised 'display-type roll of doors,' and the team teaser and three-step rail are conventional, uninteractive filler — correct and on-brief, but a page that is right isn't yet a page that stops the scroll.
tasteReview.contactListAnswer: Overlapping broker faces at display scale, branded H1, boutique Central Oregon buy-and-sell sentence, 5.0 from 25 Google reviews, then reviews as words, dated closings, Call/Text/Email/Schedule, office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 plus firm OREA, and a one-line inquiry to /contact. No three equal broker Cards. No Meet-the-Team dump.

Lowered heroImageWidth/Natural with that reason. 2026-09-23 re-seed (Matt's About-page AEO playbook): every page-level floor only RAISED, never lowered (each number is the max of the 2026-09-12 floor and the new seed; heroImageWidth keeps 400). sectionDepth floors added for the seven playbook-and-closing sections whose words do not move with live review text or the atlas feed (services, different, clients, how-we-work, about, key-facts, faq).
